var config = queries.GetConfig.data

Object.keys(config.cams).forEach(key => {
  var x = config.cams[key].axes.x.weight
  var z = config.cams[key].axes.z.weight
  
  actions.setPageVariable('cams.' + key + '.x.weight', x)
  actions.setPageVariable('cams.' + key + '.z.weight', z)

  actions.setPageVariable('solver.relativeCost', config.solver.relativeCost)
  actions.setPageVariable('solver.absoluteCost', config.solver.absoluteCost)
  actions.setPageVariable('solver.maxIterations', config.solver.maxIterations)
  actions.setPageVariable('solver.maxEvaluations', config.solver.maxEvaluations)
  actions.setPageVariable('window', config.window)
  actions.setPageVariable('replay', config.replay)

  components['c' + key + 'x'].setValue(String(x))
  components['c' + key + 'z'].setValue(String(z))

  components.relCost.setText(config.solver.relativeCost)
  components.absoluteCost.setText(config.solver.absoluteCost)
  components.iterationsLimit.setText(config.solver.maxIterations)
  components.evaluationsLimit.setText(config.solver.maxEvaluations)
  components.window.setText(config.window)
  components.replay.setText(config.replay)
})
